title: ContactPointAddress - Data API
description: Represents a contact’s billing or shipping address, which is associated with an individual or person account. This object is available in API version 49.0 and later.

ActiveFromDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ActiveFromDate.description: The date when the contact’s address became active.

ActiveToDate.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ActiveToDate.description: The date when the contact’s address is no longer active.

AddressType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AddressType.description: Indicates the type of address. Possible values are: Billing Shipping

BestTimeToContactEndTime.description: The latest time to contact the individual.

BestTimeToContactStartTime.description: The earliest time to contact the individual.

BestTimeToContactTimezone.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
BestTimeToContactTimezone.description: The time zone applied to the best time to contact the individual.

City.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

ContactPointPhoneId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ContactPointPhoneId.description: Represents the primary phone number associated with this address. This is a relationship field.

Country.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

GeocodeAccuracy.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
GeocodeAccuracy.description: The level of accuracy of a location’s geographical coordinates compared with its physical address. A geocoding service typically provides this value based on the address’s latitude and longitude coordinates. Possible values are: Address Block City County ExtendedZip NearAddress Neighborhood State Street Unknown Zip

IsDefault.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsDefault.description: Indicates whether a contact’s address is the preferred method of communication (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

IsPrimary.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsPrimary.description: Indicates whether a contact’s address is their primary address (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

IsThirdPartyAddress.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsThirdPartyAddress.description: Indicates whether the address is associated with a third party (true) or not (false). The default value is false. This field is available in API version 57.0 and later.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last referenced a record related to this record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record. If this value is null, it’s possible that this record was referenced (LastReferencedDate) and not viewed.

Latitude.description: Used with Longitude to specify the precise geolocation of the address. Acceptable values are numbers between –90 and 90 with up to 15 decimal places.

Longitude.description: Used with Latitude to specify the precise geolocation of the address. Acceptable values are numbers between –180 and 180 with up to 15 decimal places.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the contact point address record.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the account’s owner associated with this contact. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

ParentId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ParentId.description: The ID of the contact’s parent record. Only an individual or account can be a contact’s parent. Because this is a master-detail relationship, users must have Edit access to the parent record to create or modify a Contact Point Address. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

PostalCode.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

PreferenceRank.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PreferenceRank.description: Preference rank when there are multiple contact point addresses.

State.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

Street.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update

UsageType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
UsageType.description: Specify the usage type of this address. For instance, whether it’s a work address or a home address. Possible values are: Home Inactive Temporary Work

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **ContactPointAddressChangeEvent**: Change events are available for the object.
- **ContactPointAddressHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **ContactPointAddressShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
